items.subject: Non-atomic reduction hierarchy depth and tile sizing
items.objective: In src/candidate.cu, compare scratch-backed, non-atomic reduction hierarchies for large n: a coalesced tiled first pass plus one final device sum, and a three-stage or other multistage variant if the partial count makes the final pass costly. Sweep useful per-CTA work and block sizes; do not assume fewer stages always wins. Keep this experiment distinct from T3 by avoiding global atomic output accumulation. Preserve tail safety, scratch bounds, and correctness for every valid input. Validate all required sizes and compare repeated whole-call timings; do not use external DeviceReduce-style libraries.
